info.title: moca-mcp
info.description: An MCP server for MOCA knowledge packages: search, navigate and cite them from any MCP client.

options.name: --trust-root
options.description: trust root for verifying package and review attestations

options.name: --require-signature
options.description: serve only packages with a valid package attestation under --trust-root

options.name: --members
options.description: directories to search for member packages

options.name: --audience
options.description:
comma-separated audiences this host may serve (default: no filter); content with
no audience label is left out unless --allow-unlabelled is given

options.name: --allow-unlabelled
options.description: with --audience, also serve content that has no audience label

options.name: --include-excluded
options.description:
also serve out-of-force, superseded and deprecated content, flagged as such
--allow-unsigned-relations apply supersedes and conflictsWith from unsigned packages (only for a library
of your own packages)

options.name: --overlay
options.description:
structure overlays the host loads over the packages: application=<file.ttl> or
organisation=<file.ttl>

options.name: --library
options.description: folders to find packages in: unpacked packages and .moca files, with their indexes

options.name: --watch
options.description: follow changes to the library folders

options.name: --preload
options.description: load packages when the server starts, not on first use

options.name: --max-packages
options.description: most packages a library may list (default 1000)

options.name: --max-depth
options.description: how deep to look in a library folder (default 3)

options.name: --max-loaded-mb
options.description:
memory budget, in megabytes kept loaded at once (default 1000): each
package counts its files plus about 30 KB a page

options.name: --max-loaded-pages
options.description:
memory budget, in pages kept loaded at once (default 25000)
Search by meaning:

options.name: --models
options.description:
where the standard embedding models are installed (default ~/.moca/models)
Models:
moca-mcp models list                 the standard models, and which are installed
moca-mcp models add <model...>       download and check standard models (the only command that downloads)
The creator's terms (applied to everything the server returns):

options.name: --destination
options.description:
where the model that reads the answers runs: provider (a third party's model,
the default), host (your own service) or device (the person's own device)

options.name: --conditions
options.description: comma-separated conditions the provider meets: noTraining, noRetention

arguments.name: PACKAGES
arguments.description:
package directories or .moca archives; use path=sidecar to bind a sidecar index
